summary_rationale: DigitalOcean has executed a sharp operational turnaround under CEO Paddy Srinivasan, re-accelerating revenue to $321.2M in Q3 2026 (+40% YoY) and ~$1.28B-$1.29B ARR, propelled by $376M in AI Customer ARR (+288% YoY) and upmarket $100k+ ARR cohorts (41% of revenue). Crucially, 90% of AI revenue overlaps with Core Cloud and ~60% of revenue comes from customers using 4+ products, demonstrating real workflow stickiness alongside a lean ~9.1% S&M-to-revenue PLG funnel. However, the business earns a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rating rather than an unconditional compounder pass because the AI/GPU pivot has compressed GAAP gross margins by ~980 bps (from 59.9% in FY2025 to ~50.1% in Q3 2026), relies heavily on cash capex plus equipment financing ($266.7M combined in FY2025), and currently generates normalized ROIC (~7%-9%) near its cost of capital while facing a two-front squeeze from hyperscalers and specialized GPU neoclouds.
